name: Steamwheedle Port
summary: Steamwheedle Port keeps Gadgetzan linked to the eastern shore of Tanaris. The neutral Steamwheedle Cartel runs its docks and holds open a sea route across the South Seas, though Southsea Pirates press nearby.

sections.title: A Gateway on the Shifting Sands
sections.body: On Tanaris's eastern shore, the docks give Gadgetzan a direct route to maritime trade. The Steamwheedle Cartel runs the settlement, where dockhands, traders, and sea captains face treacherous waters. Supply vessels sail between the port and distant goblin trading posts, bringing mechanical components, luxuries, and raw materials into southern Kalimdor.

sections.title: Pirates and Strange Scholars
sections.body: Southsea Freebooters raid goblin shipping from Lost Rigger Cove, just south along the coast. They steal cargo and contest control of the shoreline, while dockworkers haggle and merchants seek to recover stolen shipments. The port also shelters unusual travelers. Among them is Yeh'kinya, a troll scholar studying the world's ancient and ominous spirits away from prying eyes.

faq.answer: The Steamwheedle Cartel built and runs the settlement. It is the primary trade conglomerate of neutral goblins, and welcomes Alliance and Horde travelers who maintain standing with Gadgetzan and the Cartel.

faq.q: Where do the ships from this port travel?
aliases: where do ships go from steamwheedle
faq.answer: Ships from the port connect the Cartel to distant goblin trading hubs across the South Seas. A passenger ship also sails across the sea from the docks to powderfuse port in the riverglades.

faq.q: Why are there so many pirates nearby?
faq.answer: Southsea Freebooters have made their base at Lost Rigger Cove, just south of the port. They hijack incoming cargo, raid dock supplies, and pick off stragglers along the shoreline, making them the chief local threat to goblin trade.

Yeh'kinya is an eccentric troll scholar resting at the port. He enlists daring travelers to go abroad and capture spiritual essences, including screechers from Feralas, for his research into forgotten, primordial rituals.

angles.text: For an engineer, the port is a valuable depot for parts and supplies imported from across the South Seas. It is also a natural source of supplies and gossip for tinkerers seeking schematics.
As a rogue, the friction between goblin merchants and nearby Southsea Pirates creates opportunities for pickpockets, scouts, and recovery contracts.
